positive: A new interface or redesign lacks a committed visual direction
A user needs a reusable design-system artifact before frontend implementation
negative: An existing site has sufficient evidence to improve without a new direction interview
A request is limited to one foundation decision such as color or typography

exclusions: Do not begin implementation before direction is resolved or explicitly assumed
Do not use worked examples as a menu or silently overwrite an existing canonical direction

required: Any existing brand or design-direction evidence
optional: Accessibility, localization, motion, or delivery constraints

outputs.primary: A decision-complete design-system artifact with explicit assumptions and readiness state

stop_conditions: Pause when contradictory or trust-critical direction is unresolved
Do not continue from multiple candidate systems without identifying the canonical one
